_comment: The parts of the station, and how to tell whether each one is up.
This file exists so start-radio.ps1 needs no editing to run on another
machine: change the names and ports here and it adapts. The script has the
same list built in as a fallback, so a missing or broken file is not fatal -
it says so and carries on with the defaults.
ORDER MATTERS AND IS THE ORDER HERE. Icecast is the transmitter; liquidsoap
connects to it and will not if it is absent. Caddy is the front door and can
come up whenever. The tasks depend on nothing.
'optional' means a part whose absence is worth reporting but is not a broken
station. Whisper is the only one today: nothing calls it yet.
